title: Vietnamese Tofu Che
description: A delicious and easy-to-make dessert inspired by Vietnamese cuisine, featuring a silky tofu che topped with fresh fruit.
instructions: Soak agar agar in water for at least 10 minutes.
Combine sugar, coconut milk, and salt in a saucepan.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until sugar dissolves.
Add tofu and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in agar agar mixture and cook for another 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and let cool slightly.
Add mau, che, and ba. Stir until well combined.
Pour mixture into individual serving cups.
Chill in the oven (set to 150°F) for at least 4 hours.
Serve chilled, garnished with fresh fruit if desired.
